notes.title: Streaming is allowed!
notes.content:
[h2]Streaming is allowed[/h2]

Many of you were asking if you could stream this game to your audience. Initially, we wanted to keep the secrets of the game for each player, but after careful consideration, and also understanding that whoever wants to stream the game can keep those secrets from the people who want to play the game.

It's fun to tease people about the plot twist in any story, just don't spoil the fun for them.

Thanks for all your support and understanding, guys!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44873072/59269ee11da9a1afa3d55f875a8b7bfd2ebe09da.png[/img]
